name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: Browse rekordbox libraries from multiple USB sticks connected through a hub.
description: Adds independent rekordbox libraries for up to eight hub USB sources on the researched XDJ-AZ firmware. Runs inside the AZ using internal member identities and loopback; physical Pro DJ Link packets are filtered. Includes a reversible compatibility patch for kernel4.4.194 and automatic hub mounting. Five sources tested in the emulator. Based on the user-confirmed0.1.4 build; extended hardware testing remains pending.
